name: Lehigh County, PA
findings: Lehigh County has 1,174 nonprofit organizations. 594 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 486 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lehigh County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
